class.name: CompositorRenderLayer
class.experimental: The implementation may change as more of the rendering internals are exposed over time.
class.brief_description: Identity token for a compositor render layer: a held-out render target drawn into by member materials and composited back by a [CompositorEffect].
class.description: A [CompositorRenderLayer] names a held-out render target. Materials that use [code]render_mode compositor_layer[/code] and reference this resource are drawn into that target instead of the main scene, in caller-controlled order, then a [CompositorEffect] composites the target back into the scene. The target is drawn at one of two declared points — before or after the transparent pass; see [member stage]. This resource is purely an identity and a small set of declarations ([member format], [member seed_source], [member stage]); it is not a policy container. The target's size, view count and depth source are engine-owned structural invariants that match the scene render target by construction. The engine allocates exactly one target per distinct [CompositorRenderLayer] instance, so several materials referencing the same resource share one layer. [b]Note:[/b] This is an experimental rendering feature and only supported by the Forward+ rendering method.

members.member: The color format of the layer target, from the enumerated compositor format set. [constant FORMAT_INHERIT_SCENE_COLOR] matches the scene's base color format.

How the layer target is initialized before its members draw. [constant SEED_SOURCE_CLEAR] and [constant SEED_SOURCE_TEXTURE] are supported. Seeding from the resolved scene color is a named future extension, deliberately not yet exposed as a value.

The texture copied into the layer target before its members draw, used only when [member seed_source] is [constant SEED_SOURCE_TEXTURE]. Its format and size must match the layer target (which matches the scene render target); a mismatch falls back to a clear. May be a live, per-frame-updated GPU texture (for example a [Texture2DRD]): the current contents are read when the layer is drawn.

The pipeline stage at which the layer is drawn and made available to consuming effects. Two values are supported: [constant CompositorEffect.EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_TRANSPARENT] (the default; drawn after the transparent pass, so a consuming effect composites it over the fully rendered scene) and [constant CompositorEffect.EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_OPAQUE] (drawn before the transparent pass, so a consuming effect that composites the target back places it under the engine's transparents). Both are post-resolve, so members are single-sample; the stage is an ordering choice, not a sample-count one. The remaining stages are reserved for a future version, and [method set_stage] rejects them.

constants.constant: Use the scene's base color format for the layer target.
8 bits per channel RGBA unsigned normalized.
10 bits per RGB channel plus 2-bit alpha, unsigned normalized.
Represents the size of the [enum Format] enum.
Clear the layer target before its members draw.
